answer: An inlet admits only what fits its channel: require hardware attestation at enrolment, a signed statement from a secure enclave that this key runs on a distinct physical device, with one enrolment per device fingerprint. A meadow looks uniform from above but each blade is rooted separately — likewise each agent must prove separate hardware. A nebula of sockpuppets collapses when the attestation check demands one device per identity, because emulating enclaves at scale is expensive and detectable, and revoked fingerprints can never re-enter the network.
